evidence.reason: judge current anchor failed verification: The current scan does not filter missing/prunable worktrees before the unpushed-work probe. An in-root candidate carrying the review branch (or sitting at the PR target path) whose directory was deleted makes `rev-parse HEAD` fail, so `atSha` is false; then `rev-list -C <missing>` also fails and this branch throws. That blocks every resolution attempt until a human prunes the worktree, and the subsequent `worktree add` can still refuse the missing registration.
